scope: Public-data computational research and falsification only. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, or clinical treatment claim.
purpose: Prevent JANUS from contacting researchers merely because a Mirror-Reverse result is interesting or useful. Promotion to outreach requires a genuinely breakthrough-level result with independent evidence and a clean novelty boundary.

breakthrough_gate.G1_PREFROZEN_NOVEL_PREDICTION: A specific prediction, inference rule, or mechanistic law must be frozen before the confirming observation is exposed to the analyzer.
breakthrough_gate.G2_INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION: The prediction must be confirmed by withheld, newly published, or otherwise independent external evidence not used to formulate it.
breakthrough_gate.G3_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_PASS: Explicit reversible or null controls must remain unflagged at the preregistered threshold.
breakthrough_gate.G4_PRIOR_ART_NULL: A broad prior-art search must fail to find an equivalent result, method, or already-known mechanistic interpretation.
breakthrough_gate.G5_CROSS_SYSTEM_OR_STRONG_GENERAL_LAW: The result must replicate across at least two independent viral systems, or establish a comparably strong and independently confirmed general mechanistic law.
breakthrough_gate.G6_MATERIAL_SCIENTIFIC_CONSEQUENCE: The result must materially change model selection, resolve an open mechanistic ambiguity, reveal a previously unrecognized state/transition/context variable, or make a successful new observable prediction.
breakthrough_gate.G7_PROVENANCE_AND_REPLAY: Inputs, freeze point, inference, unblinding, controls, and scoring must be independently replayable without post-hoc retargeting.

outbound_firewall.unlock_condition: terminal == SCIENTIFIC_BREAKTHROUGH and all breakthrough_gate fields have independent PASS receipts

prior_art_kills_from_TOPA_SPIDER_pass_20: viral capsid assembly/disassembly hysteresis and metastability are established prior art
detailed-balance and time-reversal-compatible capsid models are established prior art
Markov-state models and transition-path theory have already been applied to viral capsid assembly
reverse-specific capsid intermediates are already experimentally reported
generic inference of hidden irreversibility under coarse-graining is established in nonequilibrium physics
cargo-shell coupling and ordered viral genome release are already experimentally reported

architecture_refinement.reason: Recent Flock House Virus work shows genomic RNA is an active coupled state variable during disassembly rather than passive cargo; a shell-only mirror representation can therefore be incomplete.

candidate_frontier.name: CROSS_MODAL_MIRROR_DEBT
candidate_frontier.question: Can a pre-frozen representation-sufficiency audit infer a missing causal variable or discriminate competing viral uncoating models from one modality and then be independently confirmed by a later/withheld modality?
candidate_frontier.current_target_class: unresolved viral uncoating mechanisms with explicit competing models and future independent observations

current_verdict.reason: The current Mirror-Reverse framework has a coherent retrospective benchmark and useful failure modes, but the obvious novelty routes overlap substantial prior art and no pre-frozen cross-modal prediction has yet received independent confirmation.
